scope: Operator-only source withdrawal and paired force-stop/new-process qualification; product unchanged.

forceStop.preparationTermination: Expected app-only force-stop of owned instrumentation during fixed readiness window.

limitations: Historical arrival loss is neither reproduced nor repaired; no end-scrolling trial is performed.
Three initial source trials stop before Start on unavailable playback. One fixed Reels-tab tap and two operator setup swipes precede acceptance.
Initial paired runner checks PID after instrumentation exits; later setup stops on a missing selected app service after force-stop. Final pair checks PID during verification.
Source regrant follows explicit Stop; active-run resumption and in-flight cancellation remain unqualified.
Force-stop is distinct from spontaneous native/JS death, OEM kill, reboot and lock; history continuity is not quantified.
Source withdrawal/restoration retains genuine consent and coverage records.
No additional source support, accessibility approval, measured resource result or production readiness.
No main merge, dependency/schema/version change, product installation, signing, upload or remote workflow.
